Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your clients' growth across European marketplaces.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, and SEMrush. I have also built and optimized WordPress sites, applying structured data and technical audits to improve visibility. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to implement data-driven strategies and measure results.

I am comfortable with numbers, Excel, and dashboards, and I am eager to learn marketplace advertising platforms like Amazon and Bol.com. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and ready to join a fast-growing team.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with Distrilink's needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Performance Marketer position at Distrilink. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical mindset and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics, I am drawn to Distrilink's mission of helping consumer brands scale across European marketplaces. Your use of the proprietary AI platform Pulse and your data-driven approach resonate with my own passion for leveraging data to drive growth.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a solid foundation in performance marketing. I conduct keyword research, optimize on-page SEO, and create content that improves organic visibility. I regularly track performance using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, and I am comfortable with Excel and dashboards. My ability to analyze data and identify opportunities has helped improve client sites' search health and traffic.

My technical background includes building and maintaining WordPress sites with Elementor and Astra, which gives me an edge in understanding the full customer journey from ad click to conversion. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits, demonstrating my ability to work independently and measure results.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to learn and manage advertising campaigns on Amazon, Bol.com, and other marketplaces. I am a quick learner, precise, and structured in my work. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and actively improving. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and ready to contribute to a fast-growing team.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can support Distrilink's clients. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web analytics. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds, tracking performance with tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs. On my own project (mirook.com), I applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Eager to apply my data-driven approach to performance marketing, including campaign setup, monitoring, and optimization across marketplaces. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads, Excel, dashboards
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)

- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
